text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-women panel is not evidence of bias, any more than an all-male one would be. Panels reflect who holds senior roles in a given organisation; in broadcasting, that increasingly includes women. Leading with it will read as an accusation based on nothing but headcount, and it will overshadow your actual grievance.

Your real point is procedural: you requested written reasons two weeks ago and got silence. That's a concrete failure you can press, politely and in writing, with a deadline.

Also take "strong experience of digital media" seriously — it's a plausible, job-relevant differentiator that fifteen years of traditional newsroom seniority doesn't automatically cover. If the reasons, once given, don't stack up, revisit then.
